title: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class
titleRomaji: Class de 2-banme ni Kawaii Onnanoko to Tomodachi ni Natta
titleEnglish: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class
titleNative: クラスで２番目に可愛い女の子と友だちになった
synonyms: I Became Friends with the Second Cutest Girl in My Class
我和班上第二可愛的女生成為朋友
synopsis: Maki Maehara is always on his own at school. He has no friends or hobbies others share, and he doesn't expect the upcoming academic year to be any different, even surrounded by new faces. And six months later, it seems like he was right-until he runs into his popular classmate Umi Asanagi at a video store! Always at the center of attention and called the "second prettiest in class" by the boys, Asanagi's from a totally different world. But it turns out the two have more overlapping interests than just the B-grade movies they came to check out...and Asanagi asks Maehara to be her friend! (Source: Yen Press)

synonyms: Uesugi-kun wants to quit being a girl
synopsis: In this gender-bending rom-com manga, one young man's wish for love will change him—literally! Uesugi Keisuke has always struggled with being short and adorable compared to his super smart and tall best friend. One day, he overhears his crush comment, "Wouldn't he be the cutest if he was a girl?!" This makes him worry she doesn't even see him as a guy. Down in the dumps, he prays at the shrine next to his house in the hopes that he can still achieve young love. However, it seems there was a major misunderstanding, because when his prayer is answered, he winds up transformed into a girl! Thus begins Uesugi's gender-bent love triangle! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Sugar Sugar Rune
titleNative: シュガシュガルーン
synopsis: Little witch-girls Chocolat and Vanilla are best friends, but only one of them can be Queen of the Magic World. To determine who deserves the title, they must go to the Human World and enter a strange competition. Whoever attracts the most human boys... wins! Here's how it works: When a boy falls for a witch-girl, she utters a few mystic words and the boy's heart will be hers in jewel-like form. It may sound simple, but winning hearts is tricky business. While Chocolat had no problem enticing witch-boys with her forthright personality, human boys seem to be drawn to shy and modest girls like Vanilla. And to make matters worse, Chocolat is finding herself increasingly drawn to the cool and mysterious Pierre-who feels nothing for her! The girls had planned to be best friends forever, but both of them want to be Queen. Will their rivalry ruin their friendship? (Source: Del Rey) Note: Won the Kodansha Manga Award for Children's Manga in 2005.

synopsis: Minato Seno’s high school life had just begun when his homeroom teacher requested his help with Nekozane, the cat-like chronic napper who sits next to him in class. Timid and socially anxious, Minato has never talked to her or even seen her face. But when he finally musters up the courage to wake Nekozane, she unexpectedly hugs him on the spot! Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, it was picked up for commercial publication with two volumes collecting the Twitter comics releasing on 2024-03-25 and 2024-04-25, with subsequent serialization in Big Gangan starting 2024-04-25.

synopsis: I found myself reincarnated as the villain in a game called “Kaleido Lily Academy.” The villain in question—Ix Vandille, the heir of the Count’s family—was a typical scumbag. Hated by many, he was condemned and killed in every scenario set in the academy. At this rate, I would die as soon as I entered the academy. However, my bad reputation knew no bounds, and it was too late to reform myself now. Therefore… “That’s it! If I become stronger than the protagonists and show them my power, they won’t dare to oppose me…!” To avoid being killed by the protagonists, I must become stronger than them. If I display my power, they won’t think of making a move against me. And if they do, I will just defeat them. With this resolve, Ix spent the three years before the academy began training desperately. “…Master, your strength is unmatched by anyone your age now.” “Hahaha! This is all due to my perseverance!” Ix became stronger than the protagonists. And soon, he began to show his strength to the protagonists, the heroine princess, noble daughters, and saintesses… but for some reason, he started being regarded as a hero.
